Risk: Android crash-free sessions below the release bar at release candidate
Mitigation: Fix the two remaining crash clusters (sync worker out of memory on low-RAM devices; map tile cache) and ship both in beta build b7
Contingency: Hold the start of the Android rollout by one week while iOS launches on schedule
Trigger: Bar not met on the release candidate build over seven days

Risk: PDF export font defect MG-2291 not fixed before feature freeze
Mitigation: Inkspindle patch 4.2.1; in parallel a workaround that bundles Noto fonts with the app
Contingency: Launch with CSV export only and deliver PDF export in maintenance release 3.0.1
Trigger: No fix merged by end of Wednesday 7 October

Risk: Store review is delayed or the build is rejected
Mitigation: Submit to both stores on the planned date with an expedited-review request ready to send
Trigger: Review not cleared one working day before launch

Risk: Sync API v3 production cut-over corrupts or duplicates records for 2.x clients
Mitigation: Dual-write to v2 and v3 for 14 days after cut-over; cut-over planned for Thursday 8 October
Contingency: Roll back to the v2 endpoints within 30 minutes
Trigger: Duplicate or missing inspections reported by any customer

Risk: Pilot crews are not available during the closed beta window
Mitigation: Confirm named crews and a backup contact for each pilot customer
Contingency: Extend the beta for that customer only; the launch date holds
Trigger: Fewer than 10 active crew members at a customer in the first week

Risk: Single point of knowledge on sync while Tobiah Kessenich is on leave in release candidate week
Mitigation: Lucinda Farthingale shadows the sync on-call from Monday 5 October and covers during the leave
Contingency: Tobiah is reachable by phone for P0 defects only
Trigger: Any sync P0 during the leave

Risk: Low-memory Android 10 devices run out of memory in the sync worker
Mitigation: Cap the sync batch at 200 records on devices with under 3 GB of RAM
Contingency: Disable background sync on the affected models
Trigger: More than 1 in 200 sessions on those models end in a crash

Risk: Regression suite runtime delays release candidate sign-off
Mitigation: Run the suite in parallel on four device farms
Contingency: Sign off on the smoke subset plus manual checks of the changed areas
Trigger: Suite not finished overnight before a sign-off

Risk: Inkspindle licence lapses during the 3.0 support window
Mitigation: Purchase order approved; licence valid to 31 July 2027

Risk: Play Data safety form is incomplete at store submission
Mitigation: Tobiah sends the updated SDK list; Dorrin completes the form the same week
Contingency: Submit iOS first and Android when the form is complete
Trigger: Form not complete by Monday 26 October
